name: Havana
about: Nov–Apr is dry and comfortable, hurricane season runs Jun–Nov with risk peaking Aug–Oct.
overview: 1950s American cars, crumbling Spanish-colonial architecture, and a music scene that spills out of every doorway.
costOverview: A mojito and a paladar meal are real but modest costs — Cuba's dual-currency, cash-based economy means prices can vary wildly by where you are.
